system.description:
In place of one of your attacks made by the Attack action, you spend a superiority to strengthen an allies defense.

Target an allied creature other than yourself, within 30 feet of you. The target’s AC is increased by +2 against the next attack made against it or it gains a bonus to its next saving throw made equal to your superiority die, Whichever comes first.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
